purpose: preregistered reconstructed_offline statistical experiment design, NOT new performance evidence, NOT reproduction of paper results

scope.channel: positive real constant gain, zero delay
scope.noise_model: ADR-015 independent circular complex sample AWGN

research_questions.primary: At the prespecified 5 dB stratum, compare adaptive C with frozen B using paired pooled information-bit BER.
secondary_descriptive: How do BER/SER contrasts vary over the proposed effective discrete gamma_b grid?
How do contrasts vary over prespecified initial mismatch scenarios?
How do estimator trajectories vary in one-factor alpha_prime, K_tilde, and shared beta sensitivity diagnostics?
How often do finite coefficient-error trajectories grow, and how often do numerical failures occur?

primary_estimand.name: DeltaBER
primary_estimand.definition: pooled BER_C - pooled BER_B from raw integer error counts
primary_estimand.sign: negative favors lower observed BER for C; positive means higher observed BER for C

gamma_grid.interpretation_limit: Grid points are proposed strata, not evidence of useful error counts; no physical HF Eb/N0 claim.

C_adaptive_primary_candidate.provenance: M5f historical fixed diagnostic profile; candidate for confirmatory preregistration, not validated improvement

shared_initial_estimate.provenance: M5f historical mismatched initial state; true a is evaluation-only

receiver_policies.difference_between_B_and_C: Only the explicitly registered coefficient-update policy; same received samples, reference bits, initial state, beta, timing, and termination.

secondary_sensitivity_candidates.design: one factor at a time; no automatic tuning; do not use these contrasts as confirmatory without a separate multiplicity policy

rng_streams.generator: SeedSequence with recorded child spawn keys and PCG64 derived generators
rng_streams.seeds_status: proposed namespaces only; freeze and archive before execution

sample_size_and_stopping.planning_rule: R0 = ceil((t_0.975,Rpilot_minus_1 * s_d / h)^2), where s_d is the pilot SD of paired per-sequence BER differences and h is the approved absolute half-width target
sample_size_and_stopping.minimum_floor_meaning: only avoids ADR-014 too_few_independent_runs heuristic; not a sufficient sample-size claim
sample_size_and_stopping.bootstrap_precision_check: Use cluster resampling of independent pilot records to assess planned interval width; pilot records are never pooled into confirmatory results.
sample_size_and_stopping.fixed_stopping_rule: After R and seeds are registered, run exactly R complete independent sequences per stratum. No interim effect-based stopping. Stop only at registered N or a predeclared hard resource/data-quality limit; report incomplete/failing runs.

multiplicity.secondary_gamma_mismatch_parameter_resul: descriptive pointwise estimates and CIs only
multiplicity.simultaneous_inference_policy: not specified; blocked until separately approved

trajectory_and_failure_policy.finite_error_growth_flag: maximum or final coefficient error exceeds initial mismatch; diagnostic only, no exclusion
trajectory_and_failure_policy.numerical_failure: retain run ID, last valid state/time, exception class and failure count; never impute zero errors or silently delete
trajectory_and_failure_policy.valid_decoding_errors: include normally in BER/SER regardless of magnitude
trajectory_and_failure_policy.missing_receiver_output: report failure endpoint; estimand with missing output is blocked, not imputed
trajectory_and_failure_policy.analysis_or_pairing_failure: retain audit record and report exclusion reason under a rule fixed before outcomes

scientific_claim_limitations: M5f observed C worse than B in its 12 exploratory pairs; retain this result and do not tune against it.
No claim of population-level adaptive advantage, equivalence, physical HF Eb/N0 improvement, or 1.5 dB gain.
B4d costs are causally generated and B5 is conditional Viterbi, not joint channel-trajectory optimization.
Cluster bootstrap assumes independent complete sequences; bits within each coded sequence are not independent resampling units.
